cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Apologise for introducing my cake by name before judging. I taught you to present numbered plates so nobody started with a favourite.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said 'another interesting attempt' before anyone tasted it. Clear diction, at least; now apologise for telling them what to expect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say you're sorry you encouraged the judges to doubt it first. Use the neutral introduction I taught you next time; I'm asking for a fair tasting, not a better ribbon.
